title: JEE Main 2026 (April 4th, Shift 1) - Physics - Units and Measurements
subject: Physics

questions.q: In a screw gauge when the circular scale is given five complete rotations it moves linearly by $2.5$ mm. If the circular scale has $100$ divisions, the least count of screw gauge is _____ mm.
questions.explain:
The pitch of the screw gauge is the linear distance moved in one complete rotation.
Pitch $= \frac{2.5 \text{ mm}}{5} = 0.5 \text{ mm}$.
The least count (LC) is given by the pitch divided by the total number of divisions on the circular scale.
LC $= \frac{0.5 \text{ mm}}{100} = 0.005 \text{ mm} = 5 \times 10^{-3} \text{ mm}$.
